finalText: Migration complete and verified. I found 10 stale files still calling `db.query` (in `packages/accounts`, `packages/support`, `packages/billing`, `packages/catalog`, `packages/analytics`, `packages/orders`) and moved each to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the style already used in the other 64 migrated files. Left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` untouched and didn't touch any `cache.query` calls. `node verify.js` now passes.
